layers.name: Product Documentation
layers.description: README, design, deployment, metrics, and asset documentation that explains what Jrd is and how it should behave.

layers.name: Web Application
layers.description: React/Vite browser UI, routing, API clients, hooks, localization, styles, and presentation components.

layers.name: Backend Server
layers.description: Node/Express backend modules for authentication, storage, imports, quote refresh, market resolution, and portfolio APIs.

layers.name: Cloudflare Edge Worker
layers.description: Cloudflare Worker entry points and API code used for edge deployment and serverless integration.

layers.name: Mobile Application
layers.description: Expo mobile screens, layouts, hooks, clients, and mobile-specific project configuration.

layers.name: Configuration and Infrastructure
layers.description: Build, lint, environment, package, deployment, Docker, Wrangler, TypeScript, and other project-level configuration.

tour.title: Project Purpose and Product Model
tour.description: Start with the README and product/design documents to understand Jrd as a private portfolio ledger for holdings, imports, watchlists, and market-aware pricing.

tour.title: Web App Entry and Routing
tour.description: Follow the Vite and React entry points into App-level routing, localization, and the main browser experience.

tour.title: Portfolio UI Components
tour.description: Review dashboard, holdings, import review, allocation, and watchlist components to see how portfolio data becomes user-facing UI.

tour.title: API Clients and State Hooks
tour.description: Study the web API client and React Query hooks that connect frontend screens to backend portfolio, price, FX, import, and watchlist data.

tour.title: Backend Request Handling
tour.description: Move into the Node/Express backend where authentication, portfolio storage, statement imports, and quote refresh orchestration are implemented.

tour.title: Edge Runtime and Deployment
tour.description: Review Cloudflare Worker and deployment configuration to understand the production edge/runtime path.

tour.title: Mobile Experience
tour.description: Finish with the Expo app layouts, screens, and shared mobile hooks used to access holdings, imports, settings, and watchlist flows on mobile.
